Name: HudsonValley Buildings
Author: oomps62
TagLine: Hudson Valley buildings including: houses, barns, coops, multiplayer cabins, slime hutch, well, obelisks, gold clock, silo, shed, Shane's chicken coop, mill, fish pond, and big shed.
Description:
Features

Uses Content Patcher to display textures.

Hudson Valley Style for all stardew building exteriors: farmhouse, greenhouse, player cabins, coops, barns, silo, sheds, obelisks, clock, slime hutch, fish pond.
Hudson Valley Style for beehouses and Shane's chicken coop.

Seasonal variant for each building - vanilla colors

Ten colorways:

    Amherst (white base; green accents; green roof)
    Cobleskill (white base; black accents; black roof)
    Fahnestock (green base; green accents; brown roof)
    Garrison (purple base; green accents; brown roof)
    Glenmont (red base; blue accents; black roof)
    Nantucket (blue base; blue accents; black roof)
    Rhinebeck (cream base; blue accents; black roof)
    Saratoga (pink base; pink accents; pink roof)
    Stonybrook (cream base; green accents; brown roof)
    Woodbury (yellow base; maroon accents; brown roof)
